negative_controls.scope:
Reject forged original-record controls and false native packet/flow metadata.

Temporary capture/manifest hashes are explicitly re-sealed where needed to reach
record-shape and provenance guards. These fixtures are never wire certificates,
and no actual endpoint-acceptance claim is derived from them.

Reject forged TCP-generation/session/page links on a source-bound capture.

Inputs are temporary metadata corruptions, never new wire certificates. Source
captures and producer exports stay immutable. No decoder sees these sidecars.
Reject missing, relabelled, reordered or corrupted capture-close projections.

limitations: Declared record-copy/reorder/drop controls are not live network impairment.
Source-certified TCP epochs and literal Wireshark groups differ on three delayed-close/copy profiles; those differences remain listed.
The new close-publication rows are nonphysical JSONL records. Clients must count physical packets separately.
A cancelled or limited export is not full projection parity.
Clear logical RPC stubs remain opaque for full NDR service semantics; authentication is not certified.
Missing new handshake, TFO and broader old/new-generation interleaving need separate recovery work.
The flow-only normalization matrix covers IPIP, IPv6-in-IPv4, GRE, VXLAN and Geneve, including outer fragments; it does not certify all negotiated tunnels.
Existing protocol/version/carrier/field/fuzz differences remain open in the main report.
